test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All Pages are Books.

All Books are Catalogues. 

Some Catalogues are Designs.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Books are Designs.

(II) All Pages are Catalogues.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram of the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6b18d9dcf2e60e70af2d794e868243d74e28cdb5a0bb6c3c79e4bba70f89f3.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Books are Designs. → **False** (as there is no definite relation between Books and designs as shown in Venn diagram)

(II) All Pages are Catalogues. → **True** (according to the statement All Pages are Books and All Books are Catalogues so, all pages are catalogues)

**Only conclusion (II) follows.**

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 4"**
